summary_en: UT Group will acquire up to 6.0 billion yen of treasury shares between November 16, 2026 and March 31, 2027 to mitigate dilution from unexercised stock options representing 16.1% of issued shares as of September 2026. Acquired shares will be allocated to stock option exercises; any unused shares will be considered for the employee share plan or cancellation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Policy for Acquisition and Disposition of Treasury Shares Related to Employee Stock Compensation Program
translation_en_brief:
UT Group resolved at its board meeting on November 13, 2026 to halt treasury share acquisitions previously dedicated to its employee stock compensation program and instead acquire treasury shares to offset dilution from outstanding stock options. As of September 30, 2026, unexercised stock options representing 16.1% of issued shares remain outstanding. The company will acquire up to 6.0 billion yen of treasury shares during the period from November 16, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The acquired shares will be allocated to satisfy stock option exercises. Should stock options not be exercised, the company will consider allocating remaining treasury shares to the employee stock compensation program or canceling them. The company previously distributed 26,451,100 shares to Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank (in trust capacity) on February 12, 2026 to secure shares for employee distribution during the trust period running from March 3, 2026 through the end of June 2028.

The company plans to fund the acquisition entirely from retained cash, which totaled 28.7 billion yen as of September 30, 2026 on a consolidated basis. Management indicated that sufficient cash levels will be maintained after funding this acquisition. For the medium-term business plan period (fiscal year ending March 2026 through March 2029), the company maintains its dividend policy of distributing profits exceeding 100% of net income attributable to parent company shareholders, with a minimum dividend per share of 10 yen.
